recorded_by: implementation agent (claims with evidence pointers; VAP-R01/R02)

findings.observed: Native Vehicle Detail 'Message seller' POSTs /api/marketplace/inquiries immediately with the literal text 'I am interested in this vehicle.'; the buyer never composes or confirms a message.
findings.expected: Opening the composer is non-mutating; only an explicit Send writes, and the buyer's exact text becomes the canonical message.
evidence: staging marketplace_inquiries 85b5921f-4441-4732-8e05-0412b868957c created 2026-10-21T03:52:36Z, source_channel mobile, text = template
findings.impact: Representational message sent on the buyer's behalf without consent; GATE-G

findings.observed: Inquiry creation is not idempotent (randomUUID per POST, no key); Native has no synchronous in-flight guard and re-enables the button after a pending/error alert, so repeat presses create duplicate inquiries, events, conversations and seller notifications.
findings.expected: A double tap or retry of one composed message yields exactly one logical inquiry and one message.

findings.observed: Native inquiries send only listing_id/inquiry_type/message/source_channel; referral_code, campaign_code and attribution metadata are never populated.
findings.expected: Referral, campaign and listing context is preserved (Marketplace V1 plan §14, directive §6).

findings.observed: My Listings tile 'Buyer inquiries' shows the number of threads (incl. Trade OS RFQ threads); its detail and the page header show summed unread MESSAGES; SellerInquiriesCard separately shows inquiry rows. One number is called by the other's name (Seller master plan I4).
findings.expected: Inquiries (inquiry rows) and conversations (canonical marketplace threads) are labelled separately; unread counts say what they count.

findings.observed: No reconciliation path exists for an inquiry without a canonical conversation; re-emitting the event collides on dedupe_key and recovers nothing.
findings.expected: An idempotent, audited, dry-run-first reconciliation path for legitimate uncanonicalized inquiries that never sends external communication, never alters inquiry text or seller identity and never fabricates replies.
evidence: docs/mvp/STAGING_RECONCILIATION_REPORT.md §2.3 (0 legitimate stuck inquiries; 81 governed quarantine; 14 pre-event 2026-06-17)

findings.observed: Seller Studio never reads publication_status/status and always shows 'Draft workspace · not public', 'Private draft', 'Buyer Preview — not public', 'Review & Save Draft' — including for the published Serena.
findings.expected: Lifecycle-aware Studio: draft → Draft / Buyer Preview / Save draft; published → Published / Public Marketplace / Edit published listing with an explanation of what an edit does.
findings.impact: Seller is told a public listing is private; GATE-G

findings.observed: For a published listing the Studio autosaves ~1.2 s after load with no edit; the server answers 409 'Only an unpublished active Seller draft can be autosaved'; the client discards the body and shows 'Account autosave is unavailable right now'.
findings.expected: No write without an edit; published listings use an explicit, audited save; success is shown only after the server receipt confirms persisted state.
findings.impact: False failure message on the Owner's published listing; GATE-G

findings.observed: Studio 'Save as Draft' on a published listing goes through /api/vehicles/add reuse, which unconditionally writes publication_status 'draft' (silent unpublish), reassigns current_seller_id/tenant_id to the saver and replaces the gallery, with no audit event.
findings.expected: No silent unpublish, no silent conversion of a public listing to a draft, no change of legal ownership; consequential mutations audited.

findings.observed: autosaveReceiptMatches compares raw client values to server-normalised values (trimmed text, de-duplicated features, JSONB key order), so a successful save can be reported as unavailable.
findings.expected: The receipt comparison judges persisted meaning, not formatting; a real mismatch still fails.
findings.impact: False autosave failure on drafts; GATE-G

findings.observed: Numerical Trust (e.g. Serena 60/100 moderate) is shown prominently while confidence (low), evidence support (0 of 7) and connected sources (0) appear only in a lower card on web and not at all next to the score on Native passport/list card.
findings.expected: Wherever a score is shown, confidence, evidence support, connected sources and a customer-facing limitations summary accompany it.

findings.observed: Every surface shows backend limitation strings verbatim, including internal terms (canonical, governed, authoritative, provenance, raw column names, 'reason:' codes).
findings.expected: A clear customer-facing summary with no internal implementation jargon.

findings.observed: runOdometerAudit returns verified=true when there are zero or one readings, for an unknown VIN and when the database read fails; the passport publishes it as odometer_consistent=true (Serena: maintenance_logs_count 0) and the web maps it to a green 'Verified'.
findings.expected: An explicit backend evidence state (not_evaluated / insufficient_evidence / no_inconsistency_detected / inconsistency_detected / unavailable); no verification claim from absence or from one observation.

findings.observed: Further unsupported verification wording: web 'Service Records' row says Verified/'signed maintenance log(s)' for any partsentry_logs row including owner/seller-stated; ledger row 'verified' for an empty chain; Native shows '0 evidence-backed facts' with a success check and renders raw trust_badges slugs; public safety copy refers to a 'verified inquiry flow'.
findings.expected: No 'Verified' unless the canonical public projection establishes it.

findings.observed: Vehicle Detail lives in the root stack; Verify reaches it with router.replace and cold-start deep links have no anchor, so hardware Back exits the app; the visible 'Back to Market' replaces instead of popping, so visible and hardware Back disagree; Inbox → vehicle loses the thread.
findings.expected: One source-aware back contract for visible and hardware Back: Marketplace → Marketplace, Inbox → same thread, Verify → Verify, deep link → Home; no loops.

findings.observed: No splash configuration (white native window until JS paints); /api/auth/me and /api/features/effective have no timeout (OkHttp default is infinite); route-boundary loading view is white; startup phases are not instrumented.
findings.expected: Branded startup state immediately; bounded restoration with a deterministic loading/recovery state; real auth failure clears the session and goes to Sign In; no fake Home.
findings.impact: 10-18 s blank white restart observed by the Owner; GATE-E/GATE-G

findings.observed: Native header control is labelled 'Notifications', opens /(tabs)/inbox and shows the sum of unread MESSAGES labelled as 'unread conversations'; a failed read looks like zero.
findings.expected: One truthful contract: an Inbox/Messages control with an unread-conversation count, or a real notification surface.

findings.observed: Owner Communications uses lg:grid-cols-[320px_minmax(0,1fr)_290px]; below 1024 px it is one column with the conversation after the full list; at 1024 the middle column is ~70 px; the selected thread is not in the URL; opening the page marks the most recent thread read.
findings.expected: Tablet master/detail with a bounded, independently scrollable list, the selected conversation visible, reachable composer, Back to list; one conversation authority.

findings.observed: Preference toggles for WhatsApp, SMS, email, push, Telegram look operational regardless of provider readiness (web owner page, Native Account and Communications); the web page turns a failed read into editable all-off switches and a failed save into silence.
findings.expected: Only channels capable of operation look operational; unavailable channels are disabled and labelled; failed reads/writes are stated.

findings.observed: Garage backend lifecycle is complete, but: nothing routes a garage registrant to the application; the applicant never sees the reviewer's reason (information_required / rejected) although the reviewer UI says they do; reapplication is not wired; the identity prerequisite for approval is never shown; create/submit are not audited; the reviewer detail shows no applicant identity or decision history; the public directory does not re-check tenant status.
findings.expected: Register → application → submit → pending → review with reason → audited decision → activation → workspace, with applicant feedback and governed publication.
findings.impact: Garage MVP journey not completable by a real applicant; GATE-G

findings.observed: No activation model exists for an independent mechanic (PO-4 in the uncarried GMO 1.0 plan: out of 1.0, must not be modelled as a fake one-person garage); registration records business_type mechanic as requested and nothing acts on it; the Help Center tells mechanics they 'can apply through the Mechanic Directory', which does not exist.
findings.expected: BLOCKED_MECHANIC_ACTIVATION_MODEL until the Owner decides; meanwhile truthful copy and the existing garage-invitation path for mechanics who join a garage.
findings.impact: Mechanic activation not available; false public promise

findings.observed: Native registration sends no registration_profile, so a professional applicant cannot record garage intent in the app.
findings.expected: Native either captures the intent or truthfully routes the person to the web application.

findings.observed: Open sailings are listed and reservable by status alone; booking_deadline and departure_date are never checked. Staging: 36 of 68 BOOKING_OPEN sailings are past deadline and departure; 24 reservations were created after their sailing's deadline (latest 2026-10-12).
findings.expected: BOOKING_OPEN + expired deadline → public booking unavailable and reservation refused; a departed sailing never appears presently bookable; stored lifecycle is not silently mutated; expired open sailings surface as operations work.
findings.impact: Bookings accepted for sailings that have left; GATE-C

findings.observed: Legacy GET /api/diaspora/containers returns every status including DRAFT to any authenticated role, and GET /api/diaspora/containers/:id embeds diaspora_cargo_reservations(*) (receiver name/phone, cargo details) with no caller scoping.
findings.expected: Draft sailings and other buyers' reservation details are not readable by unrelated users.

findings.observed: Web Owner Dashboard SafePay card sums e.amount/e.currency while the live shape is listing_amount/listing_currency (always $0), and counts settled/cancelled sessions as 'active purchase escrows'.
findings.expected: No false zero; only in-progress sessions counted as in progress; empty vs failed distinguishable.

findings.observed: A user with no referral wallet row (the normal first-use state) sees the raw error 'Referral wallet not found.' on web and Native.
findings.expected: A truthful first-use state.

findings.observed: Help Center popular-search chip 'ZINARA clearance' can never match an FAQ (only typing 'ZINARA' matches two), and clicking a chip also clears the category while typing does not.
findings.expected: A chip executes the same search semantics as manual input.

findings.observed: Marketplace Pulse rollups have no scheduler, so an owner with vehicles always sees 'Intelligence for this period could not be read' — wording that suggests a fault rather than a capability that is not computed.
findings.expected: 'Not available' is valid MVP behaviour; computation deferred to V2.

findings.observed: Staging state drift (read-only report): 3 retry_scheduled external notifications; 4 garage registration profiles in_review with no application; 2 lowercase 'available' statuses; 36 expired BOOKING_OPEN sailings; 26 REQUESTED reservations on departed sailings.
findings.expected: Dispositioned through audited, separately authorized transitions (proposed ledger M1-M7), never by deletion.

findings.observed: Terms and Privacy are Draft pending Owner/legal approval; commercial model, jurisdiction, refunds, contacts, retention, DSR, consent and processor language are undecided.
findings.expected: Owner/legal approval before Production.

findings.observed: Garage approval requires the applicant's governed identity approval, which depends on the vision provider; there is no manual path (open O2 owner decision).
findings.expected: Approval runtime proof needs a legitimately approved applicant identity; no identity evidence may be fabricated.

findings.observed: Native sign-in started from 'Message seller' returns the buyer to Home instead of the vehicle; the Native thread 'Open vehicle' pushes the vehicle without return context.
findings.expected: Return to the same vehicle / same thread.
